raw_blocks: Our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination

CarGurus was founded in 2006 to bring more trust and transparency to car shopping. Today, with decades of experience in the rearview, CarGurus is the #1 most-visited digital auto platform in the United States.* Powered by industry-leading innovation and insights, we give our consumer and dealer customers the confidence to buy or sell a car exactly how they want, making every step more seamless from online to the dealership lot.

CarGurus believes everyone should be in control of their purchase or sale from start to finish. With our unmatched inventory, unbiased vehicle information, and tools for buying, financing, and selling, our consumers find what they’re looking for at the right price, and have more flexibility along the way. CarGurus gives each car a deal rating from great to overpriced and our Best Match sort order helps our consumers find their best deal. Our sort showcases recommended vehicles based on a variety of factors, including shopper engagement, vehicle attributes, photos, and dealer reviews & services.
Enabling dealership success at every turn

CarGurus is trusted by tens of thousands of dealers to maximize revenue in an evolving automotive landscape. Powered by our unmatched audience and decades of insights and experience, we partner with our dealer customers to help them source, market, and sell each vehicle at the right price: locally, online, or out-of-market.

Empowering consumers and dealers starts with empowering our own team. CarGurus provides our employees with support, resources, and opportunities to contribute to industry-defining technology, empower customers across the globe, and continuously grow in their career and life.
CarGurus is founded by Langley Steinert, co-founder of TripAdvisor.
Instant Market Value launches to provide complete transparency on a car's value and deal rating.
The first-annual Top-Rated Dealer Awards recognize dealers who go above and beyond for their customers.
CarGurus expands internationally, launching in Canada and the UK.
CarGurus goes public with an IPO on the NASDAQ stock exchange under the ticket symbol "CARG."
CarGurus acquires PistonHeads, the UK-based motoring community and automotive marketplace.
CarGurus acquires Autolist, an innovative car shopping platform, expanding the consumer audience.
New digital retail tools allow drivers and dealers to do more of the sale online, including financing and appointment booking.
AI-powered shopping experience launches, unlocking a more personalized and intuitive research option right on the CarGurus website
Certain professional photographs included on this website are credited to © Krista Guenin
